page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr9i.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. There are no integrated graphics processing units on this instance. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 36 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this instance.

The high memory density of 8.0 GB per core positions this instance as a memory-optimized resource. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention. However, the lack of local storage and GPU accelerators represents a tradeoff, requiring external storage configurations and limiting its applicability for hardware-accelerated workloads.

Given the memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated processing cores, this instance is configured for memory-intensive workloads. Suitable applications include in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines.
